manualExtractionRows.sourceTitle: IWGDF/IDSA Guidelines on the Diagnosis and Treatment of Diabetes-Related Foot Infections
manualExtractionRows.sourceIdentityFinding: Official IDSA page identifies the intended IWGDF/IDSA 2023 diabetic-foot-infection guideline route after the original automated HTTP 525 issue was resolved to a reachable official page route.
manualExtractionRows.currentnessBoundary: Use only the recorded official page route and version context; do not infer later updates, local protocol, antibiotic choice, wound-care instruction, offloading decision, amputation-risk advice or calibrated outcome prediction without independent fresh review.
manualExtractionRows.exactClaimUse: Use only as bounded source-context input for independent fresh review of diabetic-foot-infection scope, wound/infection variable boundaries and downgrade triggers; do not create artifacts until fresh-review verdict and reviewed-artifact gate pass.
manualExtractionRows.endpointDefinition: Diabetes-related foot infection guideline scope, infection presence or severity vocabulary, wound burden, infection complication boundary, care-pathway burden and possible amputation-risk context; not individualized treatment selection.
manualExtractionRows.populationOrSetting: People with diabetes-related foot wounds or suspected diabetic-foot infection in clinical care contexts; transfer to pressure ulcers, venous ulcers or non-diabetic wounds requires separate source review.
manualExtractionRows.effectOrMechanismSignal: The route can support chronic-wound continuity framing by linking wound status, infection risk, guideline-defined infection assessment and care burden as variables that can interrupt mobility, repair and future action capacity.
manualExtractionRows.uncertaintyOrBias: Guideline statements are not calibrated individual outcome estimates; applicability varies by diabetes status, vascular disease, infection severity, setting, diagnostic resources and local antimicrobial practice.
manualExtractionRows.transferBoundary: Do not transfer into wound-care instructions, antibiotic selection, debridement/offloading decisions, amputation-risk advice, individual medical advice, clinical validity claims or longevity prediction.
downgradeTriggers: Block artifact promotion if official route identity, guideline scope or page version cannot be independently verified.
Block if a claim would become wound-care advice, infection-management advice, treatment selection, individual prognosis or calibrated prediction.
Downgrade if the domain transfer moves beyond diabetes-related foot infection into other chronic wound types without a separate source.
